copper.name: Copper
copper.role: Cheap early metal between stone and iron. Conducts static: copper armour makes static charge worse.

steel.name: Steel
steel.role: Iron refined with coal in the alloy furnace: tougher and longer-lasting than iron. The structural metal.

embersteel.name: Embersteel
embersteel.role: Steel forged with emberite from the Ashen Hollows: weapons set targets alight, armour shields from heat and fire.

rimesteel.name: Rimesteel
rimesteel.role: Steel tempered with Everfrost cryolite: weapons slow what they hit, armour keeps the cold out.

galvanic.name: Galvanic
galvanic.role: Copper bronzed with Stormstone galvanite: very fast to mine and swing, grounds static, shocks wet targets.

starsilver.name: Starsilver
starsilver.role: Light Starlight Caverns metal: fast tools, the best enchanting, light armour; strikes the undead harder.

umbralite.name: Umbralite
umbralite.role: The Abyss' dense black metal: the strongest general equipment; heavy blows pierce armour.

nacre.name: Nacre
nacre.role: Pearl and shell from the flooded regions: diving gear (long breath, fast swimming, underwater mining) and weapons that hit hard in water.

fossil.name: Fossil
fossil.role: Petrified bone and jasper: cheap, heavy blunt weapons and sturdy armour that resists knockback.

malachite.name: Malachite
malachite.role: Hollow Peaks stone that holds an edge forever: very durable tools for long mining trips.

fur.name: Furlined
fur.role: Warm clothing from shed fur: light protection that keeps out the Everfrost cold.

scale.name: Scale
scale.role: Overlapping shed scales: light armour that swims well.

shell.name: Shellplate
shell.role: Sealed shell plates with silk seams: keeps spores and fumes out.

silk.name: Silkweave
silk.role: Light woven silk: the explorer's clothing, quick on the feet and soft landings.

glimmer.name: Glimmer
glimmer.role: Crystal Deep glimmer: luminous lenses, lanterns and a stiletto that marks its targets.
